title.narrative: CyberSEE ¿ Co-operation on Cybercrime: Enhanced action on cybercrime and electronic evidence in South-East Europe and Türkiye

description.narrative:
The objective of the Action is to enhance the capacities of South-East-Europe and Türkiye for a more effective criminal justice response to cybercrime and electronic evidence in view of strengthening the rule of law, security and regional co-operation.

This is to be achieved through threeexpected results related to improved legislation and policies, enhanced capacities of criminal justice authorities for investigation, prosecution and adjudication of cybercrime, and co-ordinated cybercrime and cybersecurity response through public/private and international co-operation, in line with the Budapest Convention on Cybercrime and its Second Protocol.
